title: Biotechnology Lab Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Biotechnology Lab Assistant - Certificate of Achievement (CA)
outcomes: Mastering Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Students will learn to follow and create detailed SOPs to ensure consistency, safety, and quality in laboratory processes.
Precise Weighing Techniques: Students will develop the ability to accurately measure and weigh chemicals and reagents, critical for successful experimentation and formulation.
Liquid Handling: Training in the proper use of pipettes and other liquid handling tools to measure and transfer liquids with precision and care.
Buffer Formulation: Students will gain expertise in preparing various buffers, understanding their role in maintaining stable pH conditions during experiments.
Aseptic Techniques: Students will practice techniques to prevent contamination of sterile materials, ensuring the integrity of experiments and cultures.
Equipment Operation and Maintenance: Students will learn to operate and maintain essential laboratory equipment, ensuring that all devices are functioning correctly and safely.
Small-Scale Protein Expression: Students will be trained in expressing proteins on a small scale, including the necessary steps for producing and analyzing proteins in a laboratory setting.
Biotech Lab Proficiency: Overall proficiency in biotechnology lab operations, encompassing a range of techniques and best practices critical for success in the biotechnology industry.
